title: Leaderboard vacancy-id guard covers only Ok responses - a late Error from vacancy A still flips vacancy B's board to Failure
evidence:
Error(err), _ -> #(
          Model(
            ..model,
            leaderboard: Failure(error_page_copy(
              err,
              copy.CtxApplicationsLoadList,
            )),
          ),
          effect.none(),
        )
        _, _ -> #(model, effect.none())
detail: The r3 lens-guard requires ApiReturnedLeaderboard to 'apply only on match'. The Error branch precedes the drop clause and matches any vacancy id, so A's late error overwrites B's Loading/Success board with a Failure (page variant: Error(_), _, _ similarly resets loading_more regardless of match).
recommended_fix: Move the Error branches after the match guard or add `, Some(current) if current == vacancy_id` to them so stale errors are dropped like stale Ok responses.

title: Demo-arm notification navigation is not revert-pinned: bypassing notification_target_path in demo_update would fail no test
detail: The r3 lens-guard requires the demo arm's pins to be revert-style. The arm test asserts only dropdown close (true even in the r2 no-op version); the navigation pin is on the shared helper, not on the demo arm calling it. modem.push opacity is acknowledged, so this is a residual pin gap, not a missing fix.
recommended_fix: Acceptable as-is given opaque effects; optionally add a comment in demo_update noting the arm's helper call is the contract and covered indirectly by the helper pins.

title: Rejected/auto-closed stepper rails still lack md:justify-end that the pipeline rail has (still present since round 2)
evidence: "flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto w-full md:w-auto md:flex-wrap md:overflow-visible md:justify-end" (line 210) vs "flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto w-full md:w-auto md:flex-wrap md:overflow-visible" (lines 321, 381)
detail: Pipeline rail right-aligns on desktop; rejected and auto-closed siblings still don't, with no stated reason.
recommended_fix: Add md:justify-end to view_rejected and view_auto_closed rails, or comment the intentional difference.

title: demo_flow_test binds notifications then discards with let _ (still present since round 2, repeated in the new deep-link test)
evidence:
let #(notifications, unread) = demo_store.notifications_unread(store)
  unread |> should.equal(1)
  after.show_notification_dropdown |> should.be_false
  let _ = notifications
detail: The read-row contract (is_read == True for the clicked notification) remains pinned only via the unread count.
recommended_fix: Assert the clicked row has is_read == True, or destructure as #(_, unread).

title: leaderboard_vacancy_id set-sites (fetch/refresh/navigation transitions) still not directly pinned (still present since round 2)
detail: The new tests (api_returned_leaderboard_drops_late_response_for_other_vacancy_test etc.) hand-build the tag via Model(..model.initial(), leaderboard_vacancy_id: option.Some(...)); no update-level test drives a fetch/navigation transition and asserts the tag is set.
recommended_fix: Add an update-level test driving AppRequestedLeaderboard or handle_browser_change and asserting leaderboard_vacancy_id transitions to Some(id).
